content_sections.heading: KRCL Junior Scale Executive Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection is based on valid GATE score and does not involve a separate written exam conducted by KRCL. The process is as follows: Only GATE 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026 scores are valid for this recruitment. Based on valid GATE scores, candidates up to 10 times the notified vacancies (category-wise) will be shortlisted in order of merit for Document Verification (DV). Only candidates who qualify Document Verification proceed to Presentation and Personal Interview. Minimum qualifying marks: 60% each in Presentation and Personal Interview. Final merit is based on aggregate marks, subject to medical fitness for the respective post. A select panel plus a standby panel will be prepared, valid for one year from declaration of results. Tie-breaker: older candidate ranked higher; if age is also equal, alphabetical order (A–Z) of name is used.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KRCL Junior Scale Executive Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application format given as Annexure-A in the official notification. Fill in all columns completely, affix a signed passport-size photograph, and clearly mention the Notification No. (CO/P-R/03/2026) and the post applied for. Pay the examination fee of ₹1,180 via NEFT in favour of "Konkan Railway Corporation Limited", SBI Belapur, A/c No. 54000000065, IFSC – SBIN0040524, and mention the payment/UTR details in the application. Attach self-attested copies of all required certificates and mark sheets (see Documents section below). Submit only one application for one post; multiple applications will result in cancellation of candidature. Send the completed application by post so that it reaches the office of the Senior Personnel Officer, Recruitment & Establishment, 4th Floor, Konkan Railway Corporation Ltd., Belapur Bhavan, Sector-11, Plot No. 6, CBD Belapur, Navi Mumbai – 400614, on or before 08 September 2026, 17:30 hrs . Important: Applications will not be accepted at any office other than the address specified above, and applications received after the closing date will not be entertained under any circumstances. KRCL does not accept online applications for this notification.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Matriculation/SSC/High School certificate (proof of date of birth and name) Attested copies of degree certificate and all semester/year mark sheets Proof of valid GATE score (2023–2026) in the relevant discipline Both sides of PAN card and Aadhaar card OBC-NCL caste certificate (Annexure-II) and OBC declaration (Annexure-III), where applicable SC/ST caste certificate in prescribed Central Government format (Annexure-IV), where applicable Income certificate for EBC fee waiver (Annexure-I), where applicable Minority declaration affidavit on ₹200 non-judicial stamp paper (Annexure-V), where applicable Proof of examination fee payment (NEFT/UTR details) Two attested passport-size photographs Experience documents, if any NOC from current employer with date of appointment, for serving Government/PSU employees

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Serving KRCL employees with at least 3 years of regular service are also eligible to apply, subject to informing their supervisor and D&AR/Vigilance clearance. Candidates found medically unsuitable for the opted post will not be given any alternative appointment; medical examination expenses are borne by the candidate. Selected candidates must execute a service agreement bond to complete training/probation (2 years) and thereafter serve KRCL for at least 3 years, failing which training/probation costs with 12.5% interest are recoverable. Selection by KRCL does not confer any right of appointment; appointment is subject to vacancy availability and satisfying all eligibility criteria. Furnishing false information, suppression of facts, or submission of forged documents will lead to disqualification, debarment, and possible legal action. Selected candidates can be posted anywhere within KRCL's area of operation, including project sites; they are not eligible for transfer to other Zonal Railways. Any attempt to use political or other influence, or indulge in canvassing, will result in disqualification. KRCL reserves the right to modify vacancies, alter the recruitment process, or cancel it at any stage. Warning: KRCL has not appointed any agent(s) or coaching centre(s) to act on its behalf. Candidates are strongly advised to beware of touts and job racketeers making false promises of securing a job in KRCL.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are available in KRCL Notification CO/P-R/03/2026?
faq.answer: KRCL has notified 5 Junior Scale Executive posts – 2 Assistant Engineer (Civil), 2 Assistant Signal & Telecom Engineer, and 1 Assistant Mechanical Engineer.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for KRCL Junior Scale Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach KRCL by post on or before 08 September 2026, 17:30 hrs.

faq.question: Q3. Is a written exam conducted for this KRCL recruitment?
faq.answer: No. Selection is based on valid GATE score (2023–2026), Presentation, and Personal Interview – there is no separate written exam.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for KRCL AE, ASTE, AME posts?
faq.answer: 18 to 30 years as on 01 August 2026, with relaxation up to 33 years for OBC-NCL and 35 years for ST candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale for KRCL Junior Scale Executive posts?
faq.answer: 7th CPC Level-8 (₹47,600–₹1,51,100), with promotion to Level-10 (Group-A) after 2 years of probation.

faq.question: Q6. Can I apply online for this KRCL recruitment?
faq.answer: No. Applications must be submitted offline, by post, in the Annexure-A format, to the Senior Personnel Officer, KRCL, CBD Belapur, Navi Mumbai.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for KRCL Junior Scale Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ₹1,180 (₹1,000 + 18% GST), refundable for SC, ST, Ex-Servicemen, Female, Minority and EBC candidates who appear in the selection process.
